Name: eIQNetworks ESA License Manager LICMGR_ADDLICENSE Overflow
Description: This module exploits a stack buffer overflow in eIQnetworks Enterprise Security Analyzer. During the processing of long arguments to the LICMGR_ADDLICENSE command, a stack-based buffer overflow occurs. This module has only been tested against ESA v2.1.13.
Targets: Automatic
